Unlike previous Ref becomingly-based or genetic algorithm searches, we directly minimize the AC1 bound by leveraging the structured sparsity induced by the Fourier basis. This approach reduces the effective dimensionality and combines the convergence guarantees of SGD with the exploitation of problem-specific mathematical structures.

   - **Formulation**: We use proximal SGD on the reduced-dimension optimization problem $\min_a (1/ε) ||a||_2^2 + \text{AC1}(a)$ subject to bounds.
